# Preservation fixtures

These are frozen, authored HTML snapshots with no live user notes. They are test inputs, not alternative notebooks or current product entry points.

- `pre-apply.html` lets structural QA compare chapter bodies, glossary, source records and notebook field names against the edition before Apply controls were added.
- `hero-before.html` lets browser QA compare the accepted content-led hero with the earlier minimum-height opening at the same viewports.

Both documents retain their embedded font notices. Current delivery is the root `research-field-guide.html`; refreshing or switching documents never migrates notebook state.
